name: Trevor Jones
title: Bassist
tagline: Shaping sound at the intersection of theater, jazz, and the orchestral tradition.
bio: Beyond the pit and concert hall, Trevor is the co-writer and bassist for Molehill, an alternative rock band with national touring credits, a Chicago Tribune feature, and an ASCAP+ Award. He is a D'Addario Artist, and Gallien-Krueger endorsed bassist, and co-founder of Double Bass HQ, an educational platform for bass players.
highlights: House Bassist & Music Coordinator, The Marriott Theatre (Lincolnshire, IL)
Co-writer & Bassist, Molehill (ASCAP+ Award, Chicago Tribune)
